en: The postcard shows a panoramic view of a European city, dominated on the left by a large, distinctive clock tower with a tiled roof and wooden balcony. The clock face is prominent, and a few people are seen near its base. The cityscape features red-roofed buildings, a river, and a bridge in the background. The sky is clear with a few clouds. In the top-right corner, there is German text.
